slides.title: Test the commute first
slides.body: Before you make an offer, ride the train you'd take to work at rush hour. Check the schedule for that station, and note whether your trip is direct or needs a transfer.

caption:
Moving to Morris County? Three NJ Transit lines connect it to New York and Hoboken.

The Morristown Line and the Gladstone Branch serve New York Penn Station, Newark Broad Street and Hoboken. The Montclair-Boonton Line serves Hoboken, with connections to New York. Before you make an offer, ride the train you'd take to work at rush hour.
